sentence: This project builds a memory management system that helps applications with dynamic memory demand perform better on graphics processing units.
This project builds a platform that uses natural language processing to give personalized recommendations for career guidance and academic navigation.
This project studies how to transform raw sensor observations so a fusion center can detect signals better over noisy wireless channels.
This project studies how microbes interact with minerals and rocks, as a step toward microorganisms capable of mining critical metals.
This project builds learning modules that use fair and explainable AI to improve security for cloud cyberinfrastructure.
This project studies how artificial intelligence agents learn to cooperate and compete with many other learning agents.
This project studies how the feeding behaviors of Atlantic cod changed over the past thousand years by analyzing chemical signatures in ancient cod bones.
This project builds a digital watershed system of sensors and data analysis tools that helps dam operators coordinate water flow and reduces flooding risk.
This project studies how the brain works out the meaning of a sentence flashed all at once, with no order in the input.
This project tests whether quantum interference of electrons can produce bright X-ray pulses from a compact source.
This project builds an open software platform that makes it easier to simulate physical scenarios such as tsunamis and earthquakes.
This project uses water-based chemical processes to modify cellulose nanofibers and make plastics with properties that can be customized.
This project develops optimization algorithms that train deep learning models more efficiently.
This project brings experts together to work on issues in the health and welfare of animals, including animals involved in research.
This project builds a network of institutions that helps university-developed deep technology ventures reach markets.
This project plans an open-access library of biofilm images and easy-to-use tools aided by machine learning.
This project studies how maize production in North America changed over the past 1,200 years by merging paleoclimate, weather generation, and crop modelling.
This project measures how fishes transport food and nutrients in large marine ecosystems and how ocean warming and fishing change this.
